evidence.observed_result: Real onnxruntime==1.31.1 (PyPI wheel). A com.microsoft.AttnLSTM model with shapeless inputs: control (rank-3 X) returns a clean INVALID_ARGUMENT, while rank-2 / rank-1 / scalar X each abort with SIGABRT (-6) and 'terminate called without an active exception' — the CPU kernel reads X_shape[2] before ValidateInputs, so the rank mismatch walks off the shape span and calls std::terminate(). RESULT: ALL TRIGGER CASES CRASHED.
